name: 45324 · Fairborn, OH
findings: ZIP 45324 (Fairborn) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45324 (Fairborn) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45324 (Fairborn) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
